title: Beachball
body:
"CELEBRATION!!!!!!! (caution: may pop near sharp objects)"

Description

Beachballs are "Fun" items that can be bought from the Radical Shack for $490. They are unanchored and can be moved around by the player. They don't serve any purpose for gaining money or materials. As of 22/01/2023, beachballs were the only item being sold at the Radical Shack, but that changed in the Valentines update with the addition of Surfboard item.

Its appearance consists of purple, green, yellow, red, blue and orange sides with white circles on top and bottom of the ball. This item uses a classic Roblox gear "Deluxe Beach Ball" as it's model.

Trivia

  • Despite what the item description says, the Beachball cannot actually be popped.
